<!--
  What HeroSplit shows beside the text: a picture, a picture with a floating card, a grid of four pictures with
  captions, or a picture with two plan cards floating over it.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { HeroContent } from "../blocks/hero-split.types";

export type HeroSplitMediaProps = {
  content: HeroContent;
  alt: string;
  media?: "picture" | "card" | "grid" | "plans";
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Box from "../compose/Box.vue";
import Group from "../compose/Group.vue";
import LucideIcon from "../icons/LucideIcon.vue";
import Stack from "../compose/Stack.vue";
import Text from "../compose/Text.vue";
import FigureBlock from "../components/figure-block.vue";
import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.vue";
import OfferMedia from "../components/offer-media.vue";
import { cn } from "../utils";

const { content, alt, media = "picture" } = defineProps<HeroSplitMediaProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <MediaFrame v-if="((media as string) === 'picture')" :alt="alt" ratio="4/3" />
  <OfferMedia v-if="((media as string) === 'card')" :alt="alt" :card="content.card" />
  <Box
    v-if="(((media as string) === 'grid') && ((content.features?.length ?? 0) > 0))"
    class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4"
    data-slot="hero-grid"
  >
    <template v-for="(f, i) in content.features" :key="f.id">
      <FigureBlock v-if="(i < 4)" class="flex flex-col gap-2" testid="hero-tile">
        <MediaFrame :alt="f.title" ratio="1/1" />
        <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
          {{ f.title }}
        </Text>
      </FigureBlock>
    </template>
  </Box>
  <Box
    v-if="(((media as string) === 'plans') && ((content.plans?.length ?? 0) > 0))"
    class="relative"
    data-slot="hero-media"
  >
    <MediaFrame :alt="alt" ratio="4/3" />
    <template v-for="(p, i) in content.plans" :key="p.id">
      <Stack v-if="(i < 2)"
        gap="2"
        :class="cn(
          'absolute w-48 rounded bg-card p-4 shadow-lg',
          ((i === 0) ? 'top-8 left-4' : 'right-4 bottom-8')
        )"
        data-slot="hero-plan"
      >
        <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">
          {{ p.name }}
        </Text>
        <Group gap="2" align="center">
          <LucideIcon name="check" :size="16" />
          <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
            {{ p.tagline }}
          </Text>
        </Group>
      </Stack>
    </template>
  </Box>
</template>
